settings.card.complianceDesc: Food traceability, İTS / ÜTS product classes and the adjustment approval threshold.
settings.complianceModules.title: Compliance modules
settings.complianceModules.subtitle: Regulated product groups your company trades in. Enabled modules can be chosen as a product category and are checked against their rules.
settings.complianceModules.desc.food: Lot and expiry tracking; recall and traceability (enforced with WP6).
settings.complianceModules.desc.medicine: Data matrix data: GTIN + serial + lot + expiry. İTS notifications are out of scope.
settings.complianceModules.desc.medical_: UDI-DI (GTIN) and lot or serial number. ÜTS notifications are out of scope.
settings.complianceModules.desc.cosmetic: Batch number tracking. ÜTS cosmetic notifications are out of scope.
settings.complianceModules.outOfScope: Live İTS / ÜTS notifications are not part of this release; only the data they require is kept.
settings.approval.title: Second approval for stock adjustments
settings.approval.subtitle: Manual adjustments whose estimated value (difference × unit price) exceeds this threshold are booked only after an administrator other than the requester approves them.
settings.stockLock.title: Stock lock date
settings.stockLock.subtitle: No stock movement (back-dated purchase, sale, adjustment, reversal) can be dated on or before this date. Protects closed periods and delivered counts.
settings.stockLock.hint: Even without a lock, movements cannot be dated before 1 January of the previous year; back-dated exits are checked against the stock on their date.
